description: This campaign compares rubble-stone walls strengthened using fabric-reinforced cementitious matrix systems, mortar injection or combinations of both. Material characterisation and quasi-static cyclic shear-compression tests investigate deformation and shear resistance. The specimens represent historic masonry, providing observations for evaluating numerical models and retrofit strategies under the tested conditions. The dataset is provided by IST, Universidade de Lisboa through BED. The structured experiment dates run from 2020-01-01 to 2021-12-31. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified.
